themes.name: Service attentiveness
themes.description: Server presence, responsiveness, and pacing during the meal, including being ignored or forgotten, slow drink and food delivery, rushed courses, and check timing. Praise for attentive, knowledgeable, or friendly servers belongs here.

themes.name: Staff attitude
themes.description: How friendly, welcoming, or rude the staff come across, including snobbish servers, dismissive bartenders, and disrespectful or discriminatory treatment.

themes.name: Hostess and seating
themes.description: The host stand experience: reservation handling and lost reservations, wait times, being turned away, table assignments, and refusals to seat incomplete parties.

themes.name: Price and portion value
themes.description: Whether prices and portion sizes seem fair for what is served, including small plates, expensive entrees, and overall value for money.

themes.name: Saltiness and seasoning
themes.description: Comments on how salty, bland, or well seasoned the dishes are, including oversalted mains and under-seasoned food.

themes.name: Wood-fired oysters
themes.description: The wood-fired or grilled oysters with chili garlic butter, including their sauce and any praise or complaints about them.

themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: The fried alligator appetizer, its texture, flavor, the chili garlic aioli sauce, and how it compares to expectations.

themes.name: Louisiana Cochon entree
themes.description: The signature Louisiana cochon dish of pulled pork with cabbage, cracklins, and pickled turnips or peaches, including its flavor and dryness.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: The rabbit and dumplings entree, including its flavor, the dumplings, and the amount of rabbit.

themes.name: Smoked pork ribs
themes.description: The smoked pork ribs with watermelon pickle, including tenderness, sauce, smoke, and spice.

themes.name: Mac and cheese
themes.description: The macaroni and cheese casserole side dish, including its creaminess, flavor, and crust.

themes.name: Pork cheeks
themes.description: The braised pork cheek dish, including its tenderness, flavor, and preparation.

themes.name: Boudin balls
themes.description: The fried boudin appetizer served with mustard and pickled peppers.

themes.name: Gumbo
themes.description: The gumbo soups, including chicken and andouille or shrimp and deviled egg versions, their flavor, thickness, temperature, and portion.

themes.name: Complimentary bread
themes.description: The warm dinner rolls and bread served at the table, including requests for more bread and whether it was brought promptly.

themes.name: Atmosphere and noise
themes.description: The decor, vibe, noise level, seating comfort, temperature, and overall feel of the dining room.

themes.name: Cocktails and drinks
themes.description: The cocktails, bourbon and moonshine selections, beer, wine list, and non-alcoholic drinks, including quality and bar service.

themes.name: Hype and expectations
themes.description: Reviews that compare the actual meal to reviews, recommendations, or media attention, and whether the restaurant lived up to its reputation.

themes.name: Cochon Butcher comparison
themes.description: Mentions of the sister sandwich shop next door, including confusing the two, preferring it, or visiting both.
